item.title: Scrap 1.0.1
item.description:
# Scrap v1.0.1 (build 11)
- If signing out of iCloud removed your notes, the notice at the top of Scrap now has a Restore Backup… button that brings back your latest daily backup - If you restore a backup and then sign back in to iCloud, lines no longer show up twice - Restoring a backup no longer leaves a "couldn't save" warning behind - Swiping to see when you wrote each line is smoother, especially on long notes - Improvements to the welcome window's design
